activity_summary: Over the third cup he went quiet, and then he remembered Kit laughing in a garden at Scadbury, two summers gone. He did not stay there. He talked of something else very fast, and the something else was the cup and Harvey, not a further life of Kit.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stopped the garden at the laugh.

entities.name: Thomas Nashe
entities.context: Went quiet, and then went fast.

facets.activity: Heard of Kit laughing at Scadbury
